Recent local reports from early October note consistent success on marabou jigs, zebra midges, scuds and small streamers during lower-flow periods. taneycomo.temp: Tailwater cold (typically ~50–54°F). Verify at the bank.
taneycomo.generation: ~20 cfs at 14:00 CT (USACE live). Overnight ~20; afternoon peak ~20. Call SWPA 866-494-1993 before you wad.

tip: Insider tip: Take advantage of the minimal early generation on Taneycomo. Drift or wade seams and current breaks with a 1/16- to 1/8-oz marabou micro jig in black, sculpin, olive or with an Indy orange head, or hang a zebra midge under an indicator.
